text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for payments-service chart@3.4.0 (values: teams/payments/2026-03-19.yaml). Namespace=payments-canary-2211, traffic=10%, replicas=3. Watch for post-canary checks: /health, /charge smoke, DB migrations dry-run.

alex.m: saw spike of 502s hitting /charge during canary smoke. stack traces point at schema validation in service config. rolling canary back? :thinking_face:

sanjay.k: copying logs from one pod:
```
I0301 12:03:45.123 service.go:87] validating config: missing required field config.rateLimit.requestsPerMinute
ERROR 12:03:45 handler.go:214] 502 POST /charge - downstream validation error
```

maria_g: hmm. the values file that went through the pipeline yesterday had a merge where `rateLimit` moved from `serviceConfig` to `globalConfig` accidentally. I flagged it in the PR but the helm values linter passed because both keys exist in different paths.

alex.m: that explains it. the new chart expects `serviceConfig.rateLimit.requestsPerMinute` to exist. Our canary values set it under `globalConfig.rateLimit`. So the app sees nil and validation fails.

ops-runner: deploy-bot also emitted a post-canary alert: `postcanary-check failed: /charge 502 rate=0.12 > threshold`. automated fallback policy = pin-to-previous-chart by default for this namespace.

deploy-bot: Automated action suggested: fallback -> rollback to chart@3.3.9 with last-known-good values commit `git rev-parse --short HEAD: a1b2c3d`. To execute manually run:
```
helm upgrade --install payments-service ./charts/payments \
  --version 3.3.9 \
  --namespace payments-prod \
  --values values/teams/payments/prod.yaml \
  --set image.tag=sha256:7f4e2a1
```

sanjay.k: i'd prefer a pin of the values rather than a full rollback if possible — we only need to move the rateLimit key back. Can we hotfix the canary values and re-run canary?

maria_g: we can patch the canary values configmap in the canary namespace quickly:
```
kubectl -n payments-canary patch configmap payments-values -p '{"data": {"values.yaml": "serviceConfig:\n  rateLimit:\n    requestsPerMinute: 600\n"}}'
```
But that won't affect chart-level changes if chart schema changed. Chart 3.4.0 intentionally removed the fallback `globalConfig` mapping — it expects `serviceConfig`.

alex.m: given that, safest is to pin back to 3.3.9 in prod and then prepare a careful rework for 3.4.0 where we add a migration step and a linter check to fail PRs that move keys.

maria_g: agree. i'll draft the release note and include the regression note + migration steps. Draft link: https://redwood-internal/notes/REL-2026-0319-payments (please review).

ops-runner: i've scheduled a manual rollback window in the release calendar at 13:00 UTC and added `@sre-oncall` for coverage.

alex.m: executing rollback now. running the helm command from deploy-bot suggestion, will monitor.

deploy-bot: Action logged: manual-rollback initiated by alex.m at 2026-03-19T13:02:12Z. Target -> chart@3.3.9, values -> teams/payments/prod@a1b2c3d.

alex.m: rollback completed. smoke checks green on /health and /charge. no 5xx observed in the last 5m.

maria_g: created follow-up ticket PAYMENT-1429 to add a CI linter rule to detect moved keys and to add a canary post-check for config schema. Assigned to @sanjay.k.

sanjay.k: taking PAYMENT-1429. i'll also add an automatic fallback mapping in the chart for 3.4.0 transition: if `globalConfig.rateLimit` exists copy it to `serviceConfig.rateLimit` (templated).

ops-runner: closing the incident in the deploy calendar and adding note to release notes that 3.4.0 is blocked until migration is implemented.

maria_g: release note updated and QA sign-off requested. :white_check_mark:

alex.m: thanks all. lesson: value-key migrations need explicit migration steps + PR linter rule.

deploy-bot: Summary: Canary failed due to values key migration. Manual rollback to chart@3.3.9 completed. Follow-ups: PAYMENT-1429 (CI linter + migration), release note REL-2026-0319, schedule reattempt for 3.4.0 after migration.
